title: e83: same-hemisphere trades give way under heat lows (declared before any e83 run)
made_after: Parameter refits on r45 exhausted (grand refits v1-v3; best feasible 0.9960). Bengal diagnosis (reports/MONSOON_R45_20261115.md): imposed north-east trades keep Bengal under northerlies until June; e80/e80b failed (deserts).
mechanism: trade_heat_low c: in both trade belts, (u, v) x (1 - c x clip(poleward pressure fall / monsoon_pressure_hpa, 0, 1)), the fall measured as e55b (last pass's pressure smoothed over 500 km). Default 0: r45 byte-identical.

screen.regions: the 14 regions of calibration/monsoon_r45_20261115 (monsoon, subtropical east coasts, deserts)

rule: A variant goes to the policy_v3 gate (dev49 + fine28 against r45) if the 14 regions' mean rain loss falls by at least 2 % and no desert region's loss rises by more than 10 %. A gate passer then gets the extra-tropical pool check (reported) and sealed set k once.
joint_refit_option: If a variant passes the screen but fails dev49 narrowly (S49 <= 1.0), one declared joint refit from it may follow (as grand refit v3, minimax of S49 and S_pool).
